name: Example OAuth
description: Reference OAuth provider demonstrating the authorization-code and device-code flows.

codes.example_oauth.consent_denied: The sign-in was not granted at the provider.
codes.example_oauth.code_expired: The sign-in expired before it was finished. Start it again.
codes.example_oauth.refresh_refused: The provider no longer accepts the stored sign-in. Sign in again.
codes.example_oauth.bad_reply: The provider sent a reply this plugin could not read.
codes.example_oauth.no_entropy: The sign-in could not be started because the application had no randomness for it. Try again.
